captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a single-speed track bicycle crankset. It features a large black-anodized chainring with prominent teeth, mounted on a five-arm spider. Two forged metallic-grey crank arms are connected to a central black bottom bracket axle, positioned 180 degrees apart. Attached to the ends of the crank arms are two flat cage-style pedals with tread grips. The crank arms and chainring rotate together as a single unit relative to the bottom bracket, while each pedal rotates independently on its own axle.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a single-speed bicycle track crankset. The assembly must include a central bottom bracket spindle, a large black multi-toothed chainring with a 5-arm spider, two metallic-grey crank arms oriented 180 degrees apart, and two flat cage-style pedals. Define a continuous revolute joint for the crank rotation about the bottom bracket axis, and individual revolute joints for each pedal rotating on its spindle.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first modeling a central bottom bracket cylinder. It defines the drive-side crank arm integrated with a 5-arm star spider and a large outer ring with teeth (subtracted using polar-arrayed cylinder cutters). A non-drive-side crank arm is mirrored 180 degrees on the opposite side of the spindle. The flat cage pedals are built using a series of box primitives for the outer frame, inner crossbars, and small traction pins, combined via union operations. Finally, continuous revolute joints are declared to connect the crank arms to the bottom bracket, and the pedals to their respective crank arm ends.
